Brampton Plan Schedule 12 mapping depicts Exception areas identify specific sites or areas where unique policies, permissions, restrictions, or development requirements apply that differ from the broader policies of Brampton Plan. These exceptions address particular circumstances and provide tailored planning direction for individual properties or defined areas.

This data is intended to be used in conjuction with other related mapping layers for this schedule, and may be impacted by other schedules, with consideration to the text of Brampton Plan.
